# Assumption of Moses Chapter 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Moses Comforts Joshua

---

**1** Moses heard him and comforted him, saying:

**2** Joshua, do not despair for your people, and do not grieve over them.

**3** God has foreseen everything and has arranged for the fulfillment of his covenant from before time began.

**4** He created the world for their sake but did not reveal his intention from the start, so that the nations would be judged and humiliated, and so that his purpose would be made manifest.

**5** He will indeed punish them, but he will comfort them again when the time of his mercy comes.

**6** For I am going the way of all the earth, but God remains faithful to his covenant.

**7** Know this, Joshua: the God who created the world for the sake of his people will act as their mediator and look upon them with compassion.

**8** He has not forgotten them and will never forget them.

**9** He will come to them again in his own time and will show them his mercy.

**10** He has appointed me to pray for their sins and to intercede on their behalf.

**11** For I am the mediator of his covenant and the prophet appointed to intercede for Israel.

**12** Go then, Joshua, with strength of soul, and serve the Lord your God faithfully.

**13** God chose me and appointed me as the mediator of his covenant.

**14** God created the earth for the sake of his people and will judge the whole world, punishing the wicked and comforting the righteous.

**15** I, Moses, have been appointed to pray for the people and to intercede for them and to give them the law.

**16** So be comforted, Joshua, and serve the Lord and do his will.

**17** God will lead his people and will not abandon them, for he is a God of truth and faithfulness.

**18** His covenant will stand forever, and his promise will be fulfilled at the appointed time.
